front.title: BGP Flow Specification Extensions for Scheduling

abstract.t:
BGP Flow Specification allows conveying flow specifications and associated traffic actions/rules to perform different actions based on traffic characteristics. One use case is steering a specific flow onto a designated path. However, in some scenarios, operators wish to chnge traffic forwarding paths over time.
This document extends BGP Flow Specification with scheduling time information to match packets arriving within different time slots. With this extension, the headend can apply different actions to the same traffic at different times.
